items.q: What areas of Portugal do you operate in?
items.a: We operate across all of Portugal, working with agencies, developers, agents and property owners nationwide.

items.q: Do you operate outside of Portugal?
items.a: Our primary focus is Portugal, though our work has already extended beyond its borders for select clients. We approach each of these projects individually, tailoring the scope, budget and logistics to deliver the same standard our clients expect at home. Reach out to discuss your project, and let's explore the possibilities together.

items.q: How quickly can I get my property media delivered?
items.a: Delivery time is typically 48 business hours for photography, 3 to 5 business days for cinematic video, and up to 7 business days for social media promotional video. We generally deliver ahead of schedule, though timelines may vary depending on requested revisions, AI server maintenance, or other reasons beyond our control.

items.q: How do I book a shoot?
items.a: Simply get in touch with us by phone or email, and we'll schedule a session that fits your timeline.

items.q: How many photos are included in one photoshoot?
items.a: Unlike other companies, we don't work with a maximum number of photographs. The total varies according to the size of the property, and we always take care to capture every angle that best presents and sells the property, tailored to our clients' needs.

items.q: Do you work in English and Portuguese?
items.a: Yes, our team operates bilingually in English, Portuguese and Spanish to support domestic and international clients alike.

items.q: Can I make changes to my project after delivery?
items.a: Every project includes two complimentary revisions after delivery. Changes involving music or AI-generated components may incur additional costs.

pillars.title: Total peace of mind
pillars.desc: We handle everything — tenants, maintenance, documentation and payments. Landlords receive detailed monthly reports with zero hassle.

pillars.title: Maximised returns
pillars.desc: Dynamic pricing strategy, rigorous tenant selection and maximised occupancy. Your property works for you — even when you're on the other side of the world.

pillars.title: Premium experience
pillars.desc: Every interaction — with owners and tenants alike — is handled with professionalism and attention to detail. Because service quality reflects property value.

about.label: About us
about.title: The management partner your property deserves
about.text1: Pixel & Property Management was born from a gap we identified in the market: property owners with valuable assets who lacked access to truly professional, transparent and dedicated management.
about.text2: Based in Portugal, we manage properties nationwide, drawing on our in-house digital department to present every asset at its full potential, driving greater visibility, stronger lead generation and, ultimately, higher returns for our owners.

items.name: Rental Management
items.desc: Rigorous tenant selection and screening, contracts, rent collection, deposit management and renewals. All handled with legal compliance and full transparency.

items.name: Maintenance & Repairs
items.desc: A trusted network of technicians and service providers. Fast emergency response, preventive maintenance and works supervision — without any owner intervention required.

items.name: Reporting & Transparency
items.desc: Detailed monthly reports covering income, expenses, occupancy and property condition. Permanent digital access to your property's complete history.

items.name: Legal & Tax Management
items.desc: Legal oversight of tenancy, compliance with Portuguese legislation, income declaration support and mandatory documentation management.

items.name: International Owners
items.desc: Fully bilingual service for non-resident owners. Communication in English and Portuguese, adapted to your timezone and the needs of remote property management.

items.name: Property Preparation
items.desc: Home staging, professional cleaning, photography and video (in partnership with Pixel & Property Digital) to ensure your property is presented to the market in the best possible light.
